description: Check Point Crypto Core is a 140-2 Level 1 cryptographic module for Windows 7, Mac OS X, and UEFI firmware. The module provides cryptographic services accessible in pre-boot mode, kernel mode and user mode on the respective platforms through implementation of platform specific binaries.
